standingLines.line: ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 2 talent has been released into your sector.

📺 The Sorting. The System empties your pack and the tithe crate onto a conveyor. Its sorter keeps the shiny and burns the useful. Redirect what matters before it burns.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The conveyor runs the length of the arena. Your pack, the tithe crate, everything — riding the belt toward the sorter. KEEP pile left. Fire right.

First up: a bundle of dull roots, a shiny bauble that sings faintly, a grey pouch of seeds. The sorter is reaching.

Nobody will say how the sorter decides.

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."
📺 RATINGS ARE UP! The producers are pleased. New casting directives incoming — Wave 3 talent has been released into your sector.

📺 The Iron Pantry. An alien vault-lock on a full pantry. Five tumblers, one hour of air. Pick it and the village eats. Jam it and the cameras watch you starve politely.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

A vault door the size of weather. Behind a glass panel: a full pantry — grain, smoked meat, winter itself, stacked and lit like a museum.

Five tumblers. One hour of air in the anteroom. The System, almost gentle: "PICK IT. EAT. THE CAMERAS LOVE HUNGER."

📺 The Echo. One witness, two tellings. The story of last night, told at dawn and told at noon — and the details moved between tellings. Find what the teller added for the cameras.

People die in this one. Regularly.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

Mabel saw something last night at the far traps. Told it twice.

DAWN: "It was big. I heard it breathing. I hid. I don't know what it was."

NOON: "It was BIG — came right at the traps, I stood my ground, it saw me and turned. I think I scared it."
